children: In a market short on fresh triggers, several stocks quietly grabbed attention on August 31, driven by technical breakouts, strong price action, and sustained buying interest.
The selected stocks are showing strong upward momentum, trading well above their key short- to medium-term moving averages, which indicates a positive trend in the near term.

Lokesh Machines shares rose 10% to Rs 367, trading well above their short- and long-term moving averages. The stock’s 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day simple moving averages stand at Rs 333.65, Rs 323.07, Rs 255.47 and Rs 233.70, respectively, indicating strong upward momentum.

Ashoka Buildcon gained 7.89% to Rs 126.95. The stock is trading above its 30-day and 50-day moving averages of Rs 117.67 and Rs 122.88, but remains below its 150-day and 200-day averages of Rs 128.43 and Rs 139.28, suggesting a mixed trend over the longer term.

Northern Arc Capital advanced 6.99% to Rs 308.85, with the stock trading above all four key moving averages. Its 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day averages are at Rs 288.67, Rs 295.19, Rs 270.80 and Rs 267.92, respectively, pointing to a positive technical setup.
The selected stocks are witnessing downward pressure, as reflected in negative price movements and their positioning relative to key moving averages, indicating a cautious market sentiment.

Manas Polymers plunged 33.96% to Rs 24.70, trading significantly below its 30-day, 50-day and 150-day moving averages of Rs 37.40, Rs 39.89 and Rs 55.46, respectively. The sharp decline indicates strong selling pressure and a weak technical trend.

DCM Financial declined 4.55% to Rs 5.04, slipping below all its key moving averages. Its 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day averages stand at Rs 5.28, Rs 5.32, Rs 5.18 and Rs 5.22, respectively, pointing to weakness across both short- and long-term trends.

Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company fell 4.35% to Rs 197.53. The stock is below its 30-day and 50-day moving averages of Rs 206.52 and Rs 222.49, but remains above its 150-day and 200-day averages of Rs 175.83 and Rs 165.92, suggesting short-term weakness despite a relatively stronger longer-term position.

Meanwhile, several stocks touched fresh 52-week high, highlighting persistent buying. Notable names touching new one-year high included Ather Energy, Piramal Finance, HFCL, Bajaj Auto, Shyam Metalics, Laurus Labs, Coforge touched 52-week high.
Niraj Ispat, Burnpur Cement, Minal Industries among others were locked in their upper circuits, reflecting strong buying and signalling bullish near-term sentiment.

title: Momentum Stocks: Lokesh Machines, Ashoka Buildcon, Northern Arc Capital rise up to 10% on sheer momentum
